title: Dates Distribution 2026
summary: Community-supported Ramadan giving: 162 kg of dates procured and distributed to people in need.
story:
During Ramadan 2026, Amaana brought together donor support for a dates distribution drive. The campaign's thank-you update reports that 162 kg of premium dates were procured and distributed to people in need in the community.

The drive archive documents the practical work behind that update: supplies brought together, individual packages carrying the Dates Distribution Drive 2026 label, and boxes handed over during distribution. These photographs connect the campaign announcement to the preparation and handover activity.

Amaana thanked the donors who supported the drive in its closing update. The reported quantity is 162 kg of dates; the available update does not give a recipient total, so this page does not convert that quantity into an estimated number of families.

title: Meat Distribution 2026
summary: Amaana's 2026 Eid al-Adha drive, documented through its preparation and campaign-labelled distribution packs.
story:
Amaana's Meat Distribution Drive 2026 formed part of its Eid al-Adha community work. The drive continued the meat distribution initiative begun in 2025.

The 2026 photographs document the preparation behind the drive. Individual containers were assembled with Amaana's campaign labels, identifying the activity and year. Close-up and wider photographs show the labelled packs together before distribution.

This page brings those original photographs into the campaign record. It does not infer the number of recipients, weight distributed or expenditure by counting visible packages. Those details require their own supporting campaign records.
